info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Capture Service API
info.description: The Card Capture Service API enables financial institutions and service providers to efficiently retrieve detailed information related to card capture events. By accessing specific card capture data through unique identifiers, users can monitor transaction statuses and enhance their fraud detection capabilities. This API is particularly useful for application developers integrating transaction management features or analytics into their solutions. Typical consumers of this API include banking software providers and fraud management systems looking to streamline card processing workflows.

get.description: Fetch the details of a specific card capture using its unique identifier. This endpoint provides all relevant information regarding the card capture transaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to capture the specified card operations for CARD-400045. The payload must conform to the expected schema, providing all required fields to successfully process the request.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the card details are returned.

GetCardCaptureByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation on the card capture service. It is expected to contain a string value.
